title: Lab - Labels and selectors
description: Query and fix objects by their labels.
scenario: Query and fix objects by their labels. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Count by label
tasks.instructions: How many Pods carry env=dev? How many objects of any kind carry env=prod?
tasks.solution:
kubectl get pods -l env=dev --no-headers | wc -l
kubectl get all -l env=prod --no-headers | wc -l

tasks.title: Task 2 - Combine selectors
tasks.instructions: Find the Pod with env=prod, bu=finance and tier=frontend.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Fix a ReplicaSet
tasks.instructions: A ReplicaSet fails to create: its selector does not match its template labels. Fix it.
tasks.solution:
kubectl describe rs <rs>
# make template.metadata.labels match spec.selector.matchLabels, then apply
tasks.verification: kubectl get rs <rs>  # READY equals DESIRED
